_comment: Local/demo test data only. Plaintext passwords here are for seeding convenience -- the API always BCrypt-hashes them server-side and never stores or returns plaintext. Do not reuse these credentials anywhere real.

users.note: Registration always creates a CUSTOMER; seed.js promotes this account to ADMIN via a follow-up SQL UPDATE after registering it (see dummy-data/README.md).
Edge case: a registered user who never adds anything to their cart or checks out -- useful for testing empty states.
